SHOT: Straight-on e-commerce packshot, 4:5. ONE necklace only, laid on the top face in a soft U, the drops facing up, on a cream plaster cube. Camera close, a little above the cube's top face, looking down at about thirty degrees. Macro-sharp on the metal.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is the supplier photograph and the ONLY authority on what this piece is: copy its construction, its metal colour and its stone colour EXACTLY; it lies on white with a matching bracelet inside it and two pink code labels: take only the outer necklace; ignore the bracelet and the labels. IMAGE 2 is here ONLY for the plinth, the camera distance, the background and the light: copy its cube and its framing exactly and ignore everything else about it.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A COLOURED DROP NECKLACE: a fine gold cable chain with about thirteen small faceted stones hanging along the front at even spacing, each in its own thin gold bezel: oval and pear stones in pale green, lilac, pink, yellow and blue, the colours alternating. Small single drops only, evenly spaced, in mixed pastel colours; no clusters, no clear stones, no pearls.

SCALE TEST: Each drop is about 5mm; they hang about 2cm apart; the chain is fine. The piece keeps its true small size against the cube, never enlarged.

GROUND: The cream plaster cube fills the lower half of the frame, large and close; flat faces, softly rounded corners, fine plaster grain. Warm cream seamless behind with a gentle gradient falloff, never sand, tan, beige or golden. Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no fingers, no model, no fabric, no props, no flowers, no box. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: warm 18k gold tone, never brassy, orange or greenish. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. No border, no frame, no paper edge, no vignette: the image fills the whole frame edge to edge.
